sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Emily.
I am happy you are here.
Today we will talk about Costa Rica.
Costa Rica is a green, peaceful,
and happy country in Central America.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Are you ready?
Let's begin.
Where is Costa Rica?
Costa Rica is in Central America.
It is between Nicaragua and Panama.
To the west is the Pacific Ocean,
and to the east is the Caribbean Sea.
Costa Rica has beaches, mountains,
rainforests, and volcanoes.
What is the capital city of Costa Rica?
The capital city is San Jose.
It is in the center of the country.
San Jose has museums, parks, markets, and busy streets.
Other important cities are
Alajuela, Cartaga, Heradia, Liberia, near the beach.
How many people live in Costa Rica?
About 5 million people live in Costa Rica.
Most people live in cities and towns
in the middle of the country.
The people are called Costa Ricans,
or Ticos for short.
They are known for being friendly,
relaxed, and kind.
What language do people speak in Costa Rica?
The official language is Spanish.
Many people also speak some English,
especially in tourist areas.
On the Caribbean coast,
some people speak Creole English.
What is the weather like in Costa Rica?
Costa Rica has a tropical climate.
There are two seasons.
Dry season from December to April.
Rainy season from May to November.
It is warm all year.
The beaches are hot and the mountains are cool.
What does Costa Rica look like?
Costa Rica has rainforests with tall trees and animals,
beaches with white or black sand,
volcanoes like Arenal and Poas Mountains,
rivers, and waterfalls.
It is one of the most eco-friendly countries in the world.
What animals live in Costa Rica?
Costa Rica has many animals like monkeys, sloths, and jaguars,
frogs, snakes, and lizards,
birds like toucans, hummingbirds, and macaws,
butterflies, bats, and insects.
In the ocean, you can find dolphins, whales, and sea turtles.
What do people eat in Costa Rica?
Costa Rican food is simple, fresh, and tasty.
People eat rice, beans, and plantains.
Chicken, beef, and fish.
Fruits like mango, papaya, pineapple, and banana.
Popular dishes, gallopinto, rice, and beans for breakfast.
Casado, a lunch plate with rice, beans, meat, salad, and plantains.
Sopa Negra, black bean soup, tamales, corn dough with meat wrapped in banana leaves.
What do people drink in Costa Rica?
People drink coffee.
Costa Rica grows very good coffee, fresh fruit juice, water, and herbal tea.
Adults may drink beer or aguardiente, a local spirit.
Coffee is often served with breakfast or in the afternoon.
What is life like in Costa Rica?
Life in Costa Rica is calm, happy, and family-centered.
People enjoy spending time with family, walking in nature, going to the beach,
drinking coffee, and talking with friends, watching football soccer.
A favorite sport, Costa Ricans love the phrase Pura Vida, which means pure life.
It means everything is good, life is simple, and be happy.
What are some holidays and traditions in Costa Rica?
Independence Day, September 15, Christmas,
with lights, music, and tamales.
Easter Week, Samana Santa, a quiet time for family and church.
Juan Santa Maria Day, April 11th for a national hero.
Annexation of Guana Caste, July 25th.
People celebrate with parades, folk dances, music, and traditional dress.
Some fun facts about Costa Rica.
Costa Rica has no army.
It ended in 1949.
About 25% of the land is protected nature.
It is one of the happiest countries in the world.
Many people live to be over 100 years old.
The flag is blue, white, and red.
Now you know many things about Costa Rica.
You know where it is, what people eat, and how they live.
You learned about the nature, animals, and culture.
Well done.
Goodbye.
Or as they say in Costa Rica, Quiravida.
